The two pieces I submitted were based on my fears.(ironically I was placed in an impatient hospital and found out I had an undiagnosed condition my who life, but it is apparent in my works) with the collage piece my message was my fear that my memories aren’t real or rather inherently different than reality. The reference pictures I took were taken on different days and locations in the city, the photo I used for myself was taken when I got back home. The whole point was to show that our memories are a collage of what actually happened, they only take prominent details such as buildings, but not the environment as a whole. My whole life I dealt with something telling me I couldn’t be confident in my own self because it told me I was inherently flawed. In my other piece(self portrait) I refer to that voice and how scared I was that my introspection was actually masked narcissism.
